description: Tier-1 self-authored Figma fixtures for the dashscene importer (see docs/decisions/figma-corpus-self-authored-only.md). Each entry maps a fixture name to the Figma file key of a file authored in the project's own account. The capture tooling fetches GET /files/:fileKey?plugin_data=shared (docs/decisions/figma-access-plan-and-pat-policy.md, docs/decisions/annotator-plugin-contract-frozen.md) and commits the returned JSON into corpus/figma-fixtures/<name>.json for offline record-and-replay (docs/design/dashc.md).
provenance: self-authored via the fixture-author dev plugin (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author); Community-license-safe because nothing captured here is a third-party file (docs/decisions/figma-corpus-self-authored-only.md).

captureParams.note: ?plugin_data=shared is always passed so sharedPluginData roles (docs/decisions/annotator-plugin-contract-frozen.md) round-trip even though no fixture carries them yet.

fixtures.name: v03-paint
fixtures.covers: v0.3 paint vocabulary under fixed layout (layoutMode NONE): solid fill, all four gradient kinds (linear/radial/angular/diamond), an image fill with a scale mode, the three stroke aligns (inside/center/outside), uniform and per-corner corner radii, and a clipsContent frame with an overflowing child
fixtures.note: Authored with the fixture-author plugin's v03-paint command (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author/README.md). Designated input for the Figma REST lowering (#139) and the Deno importer (#17).

fixtures.name: grid-basic
fixtures.covers: GRID mode: row/column spans, fixed+flex tracks, hug/fill/fixed children, min/max constraints
fixtures.note: Refused by name until the v0.8 layout-fidelity slice: the walk diagnoses grid auto-layout (GRID) and skips the subtree (docs/decisions/figma-flex-lowering.md D5). Captured now so the v0.8 grid lowering starts from pinned shapes.

fixtures.name: variables-bound
fixtures.covers: boundVariables on color + number props across light/dark modes; one subtree pinned to dark
fixtures.note: designated input for token-resolution phase 1 (sidecar) and phase 2 (id->name join), docs/decisions/token-resolution-phase-split.md; raw compile is still refused: the Fill cards sit on the hug root's axis (a Figma-vs-CSS sizing divergence, docs/decisions/figma-flex-lowering.md D5). The TEXT children lower since #160; the Fill-in-hug divergence is the one remaining refusal.

fixtures.name: effects-2025
fixtures.covers: REJECT-list constructs: noise, texture, progressive blur
fixtures.note: DIAGNOSTIC fixture (corpus/figma-fixtures/README.md): under R6 emits no .dsb; the test asserts the diagnostic report names each construct as an error. Variable-width stroke (4th REJECT construct) pending manual application — no plugin API.

fixtures.name: lowering-wrap
fixtures.covers: WRAP auto-layout: fixed-width children wrapping at a fixed container width
fixtures.note: Refused by name until the v0.8 layout-fidelity slice: the walk diagnoses wrapping auto-layout (WRAP) and skips the subtree (docs/decisions/figma-flex-lowering.md D5).

fixtures.name: lowering-hug-in-fill
fixtures.covers: HUG child inside a FILL container (Figma->CSS sizing lowering) with a HUG TEXT leaf
fixtures.derivedEmits: the TEXT leaf swapped for a FRAME fixed at its captured box (crates/dashc/tests/flex_lowering.rs) emits goldens/dsb/v07-hug-in-fill-derived.dsb and solves to the captured rects font-free
fixtures.note: Raw compile emits since #160 (text lowering): the HUG text leaf lowers with its characters and style (goldens/dsb/v07-text-hug-in-fill.dsb), and the scene solves through the measure callback and paints (goldens/images/v07-text-lowering.png). The auto-layout chain lowers since #140. The TEXT->FRAME derivation is kept as a font-free solve-fidelity check.

fixtures.name: lowering-negative-gap
fixtures.covers: negative itemSpacing (-16) overlap row, lowered to margins (docs/design/dashbuf.md)
fixtures.derivedEmits: the ELLIPSE children retyped as FRAMEs (crates/dashc/tests/flex_lowering.rs) emit goldens/dsb/v07-negative-gap-derived.dsb and solve to the captured rects
fixtures.note: Raw compile is refused only by the ELLIPSE children (shape nodes have no lowering story yet); the negative-gap lowering itself lands since #140. Root hug width solve is engine debt #236.

fixtures.name: lowering-baseline
fixtures.covers: mixed-size BASELINE alignment row (docs/technotes/open-questions.md, Q-4) + Arabic RTL run with Arabic-Indic numerals (E2)
fixtures.derivedEmits: with the root's BASELINE cross-axis alignment lifted to MIN (crates/dashc/tests/text_lowering.rs), the mixed-size Latin rows and the Arabic RTL run lower and emit goldens/dsb/v07-text-baseline-derived.dsb
fixtures.note: Refused raw until the v0.8 layout-fidelity slice: the walk diagnoses cross-axis alignment BASELINE at the root and skips the subtree (Q-4). The TEXT children lower since #160, which names this file as its designated text input; a declared derivation lifts only the BASELINE refusal to exercise them. The Arabic run is basic Arabic (U+0621-U+064A), so #228 (extended-Arabic joining sweep) does not fire and re-defers.

fixtures.name: lowering-variant-topology
fixtures.covers: component set whose variants have different child counts (topology change) + one instance
fixtures.note: Raw compile is refused today: COMPONENT_SET/COMPONENT/INSTANCE node types have no lowering yet, and the root pins the dashed-stroke shape (debt #145). Captured for the variant-topology work.
